other_conditions: The marriage must be legally performed and registered at the Office of the Registrar, Marriages
The marriage must be between a Scheduled Caste (SC) spouse and a non‑SC spouse
At least one spouse must be a permanent resident of NCT of Delhi
If the non‑SC spouse belongs to another state, their parents must have resided in NCT of Delhi for at least five years
The non‑SC spouse must provide proof that their caste is not listed under untouchability in their home state and that they follow the Hindu religion
After marriage, the couple must reside in the NCT of Delhi
The couple must provide proof of living together at the time of fund disbursement
A widow of up to 35 years of age with no children can avail of the incentive upon inter‑caste remarriage
benefits_summary: One‑time financial incentive of ₹50,000 per eligible inter‑caste couple.
documents_required: Marriage registration certificate from the Office of the Registrar, Marriages
Proof of residence in NCT of Delhi
Proof of living together at the time of disbursement
Proof that the non‑SC spouse’s caste is not listed under untouchability in their home state
Proof of Hindu religion of the non‑SC spouse
